_comment: 生成物，别手改。scripts/export-codex.ts 从 data/vanilla/skills 里藏起来的第 6 行生成。

desc.zh: 水师先登提督专擅短兵相接，敢死先登，身先士卒。
desc.en: The first to board and the first into the breach, this admiral leads every assault from the front.

lines.zh: 可直接从海上攻击沿海城镇的驻军，无需先行登陆（领主军队）
lines.en: Allows attacking coastal settlement garrisons directly from the sea, without needing to land first (Lord's army)

lines.zh: 领导力：近战步兵部队+8（领主军队）
lines.en: Leadership: +8 for Melee Infantry units (Lord's army)

lines.zh: 近战攻击：近战步兵部队+6（领主军队）
lines.en: Melee attack: +6 for Melee Infantry units (Lord's army)

desc.zh: 水师炮令提督坐镇中军楼船，统一校准水师火炮与铳手节律。
desc.en: From the fleet's command ship, this admiral coordinates every gun crew and every volley.

lines.zh: 可直接从海上攻击沿海城镇的驻军，无需先行登陆（领主军队）
lines.en: Allows attacking coastal settlement garrisons directly from the sea, without needing to land first (Lord's army)

lines.zh: 补员速率：+6%（此军队及影响力范围内所有军队）
lines.en: Casualty replenishment rate: +6% (this force and all forces in circle of influence)

lines.zh: 新募部队经验等级：+2（火器与炮兵部队）（领主军队）
lines.en: Recruit rank: +2 for gunpowder and artillery units (Lord's army)

lines.zh: 远程伤害：+5%（远程部队，基础与破甲同时）（领主军队）
lines.en: Missile damage: +5% for missile units, base and armour-piercing alike (Lord's army)

desc.zh: 驭潮者听得见风底下的东西，潮汐涨落有自己的语言，读得懂的人永远比风暴先到一步。凡在提督舰影响力范围内的友军，都跟着他走这条快路。
desc.en: One who masters the tide hears what lies beneath the wind. The ebb and flow have a language of their own, and whoever can read it is always a step ahead of the storm. Any allied army within his ship's circle of influence travels that faster road with him.

lines.zh: 可直接从海上攻击沿海城镇的驻军，无需先行登陆（领主军队）
lines.en: Allows attacking coastal settlement garrisons directly from the sea, without needing to land first (Lord's army)

lines.zh: 战略地图移动距离：+10%（此军队及影响力范围内所有军队）
lines.en: Campaign movement range: +10% (this force and all forces in circle of influence)

lines.zh: 新募部队经验等级：+2（骑兵部队，不含领主与英雄）（领主军队）
lines.en: Recruit rank: +2 for cavalry units (excluding lords and heroes) (Lord's army)

lines.zh: 骑兵部队获得属性：地形适性（不含领主与英雄）（领主军队）
lines.en: Attribute: Strider for cavalry units (excluding lords and heroes) (Lord's army)
